scripts.create: await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('210:7'));const root=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('470:17083'),grid=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('470:17087'),label=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('470:17085');if(root.children.some(n=>n.name==='iPad landscape entries'))throw Error('Already created');const h1=label.clone(),h2=label.clone(),h3=label.clone(),land=grid.clone(),portrait=grid.clone();h1.name='iPhone entries heading';h2.name='iPad landscape heading';h3.name='iPad portrait heading';land.name='iPad landscape entries';portrait.name='iPad portrait entries';root.insertChild(3,h1);root.insertChild(5,h2);root.insertChild(6,land);root.insertChild(7,h3);root.insertChild(8,portrait);root.primaryAxisSizingMode='AUTO';return {root:root.id,headings:[h1.id,h2.id,h3.id],grids:[land.id,portrait.id],createdNodeIds:[h1,h2,h3,land,portrait].flatMap(n=>[n.id,...('findAll' in n?n.findAll(()=>true).map(x=>x.id):[])]),mutatedNodeIds:[root.id]};
